author: Priya S.
text: Two PAX wardrobes and a bed frame, done in an afternoon. They levelled everything on our sloped floor, anchored the wardrobes without me asking twice, and left with every scrap of cardboard. Booking to finished was three days.

author: Dan M.
text: Picked up a sectional from the Queensway IKEA and had it in our living room before noon. Price was exactly what the calculator said. No surprise fuel charge, no waiting-around charge.

author: Ashley T.
text: Moved a sofa and a dresser from Brampton to my mum's in Oakville. They were very clear on the phone that it is curbside only, which I appreciated because I had the garage ready at both ends. Straightforward, on time.

author: Marcus O.
text: Good work on a treadmill and a squat rack. They ran about forty minutes late because of the 401, but they called ahead to say so rather than leaving me guessing, and they stayed until it was properly done.

author: Fatima H.
text: We had eighteen student suites to furnish before September. Assembleo worked evenings so we did not lose the building, gave us a photo record per unit, and invoiced on terms. Doing it again next year.

author: Greg W.
text: A crib at 7pm on short notice because the baby came early. They found a slot, brought the right tools, and checked every fixing twice. Hard to overstate how much that helped that week.
